# Apple Podcasts

> > Apple Podcasts is the premier destination for discovering, streaming, and exploring millions of podcasts across news, true crime, entertainment, and educational content.

Apple Podcasts serves as a comprehensive podcast platform featuring curated collections, trending charts, and individual podcast series from major publishers like The New York Times, NBC News, iHeartPodcasts, and independent creators. The platform emphasizes podcast discovery through new releases, category browsing, and editorial curation.

## Browse & Discover

- [Top Podcast Charts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/charts): View trending and top-ranked podcasts across all categories
- [New Podcast Releases](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/new): Browse new podcast releases and featured content on Apple Podcasts
- [New Shows Collection](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/room/555360674): Curated collection of new podcast releases and discoveries

## True Crime & Investigation

- [Crime Junkie](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/crime-junkie/id1322200189): True crime podcast investigating cold cases and missing persons
- [Dateline NBC](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/dateline-nbc/id1464919521): NBC News true crime investigations hosted by Lester Holt
- [Bridge of Lies](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/bridge-of-lies/id1874641982): ABC News true crime series investigating Sarah Stern murder case
- [Killer In The Code](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/killer-in-the-code/id1863557288): Cold case investigation of Black Dahlia and Zodiac Killer by Michael Connelly
- [Off Duty | The Guardian Investigates](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-birth-keepers-i-choose-this/id1731314182): True crime investigation into Chicago police misconduct and wrongful conviction
- [Someone's Hunting Us](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/someone%E2%80%99s-hunting-us/id1870901751): Serial killer investigation focusing on violence against Black women
- [City of Lights](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/city-of-lights/id1867051800): Cold case investigation of unsolved murder in Aurora, Illinois

## News & Current Affairs

- [The Daily](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-daily/id1200361736): Daily news podcast from The New York Times with Michael Barbaro
- [Pod Save America](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/pod-save-america/id1192761536): Political analysis and news commentary from Crooked Media hosts

## Entertainment & Culture

- [The Joe Rogan Experience](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-joe-rogan-experience/id360084272): Long-form interview and comedy podcast hosted by Joe Rogan
- [The Secret World of Roald Dahl](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-secret-world-of-roald-dahl/id1868436905): Roald Dahl biography podcast hosted by Aaron Tracy on iHeartPodcasts
- [Real Vikings](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/real-vikings/id1876255143): Viking history narrative hosted by Iain Glen from Noiser

## Lifestyle & Personal Development

- [The Psychology of Relationships](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-psychology-of-relationships/id1852111386): Relationship psychology and dating advice from Julie Krafchick & Yue Xu
- [Business Book Club](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/business-book-club/id1867175754): Business book discussions and entrepreneurship insights with Sam Brown
- [Mick Unplugged](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/mick-unplugged/id1731755953): Self-improvement and personal development podcast with Mick Hunt

## Optional

- [Sound, Light & Frequency](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/sound%2C-light-%26-frequency/id1876651405): UFO disclosure and conspiracy investigation from iHeartPodcasts
